description: Figure 8, titled "Problem distribution based on the correctness under the w/ knowledge and w/o knowledge settings using Zero-Shot," is a pie chart that visually represents the distribution of problem correctness. The chart is divided into two distinct colored sections: a larger, light gray segment and a smaller, dark gray segment. The light gray section, which occupies the majority of the pie, represents the proportion of problems that were answered correctly under the "w/ knowledge" setting. The dark gray section, which is significantly smaller, represents the proportion of problems that were answered correctly under the "w/o knowledge" setting. The chart clearly illustrates that the model's performance, as measured by correctness, is substantially higher when relevant knowledge is provided.
